scenarios.milestone: Kickstart 1.3 no-disk insert-hand screen renders without distortion.
notes: Primary visual baseline for the Kickstart 1.3 insert-hand regression.
Reference image should be captured from FS-UAE/WinUAE using the same ROM hash.

scenarios.milestone: Workbench 1.3 boots from DF0 ADF to a usable desktop.
notes: Tracks floppy, CIA timer, OCS viewport, and Workbench input-readiness in one boot path.

scenarios.milestone: Twenty approved OCS titles reach documented menu/gameplay/demo milestones.
notes: Catalog group placeholder; expand into per-title scenarios as legally usable assets are selected.
Each title must record a milestone, reference emulator result, and failure owner.

scenarios.milestone: Workbench 2.x boots from ADF with ECS display behavior.
notes: Proves ECS register and Workbench 2.x baseline before broader ECS corpus work.

scenarios.milestone: A600 profile boots a Gayle IDE HDF and reports safe geometry/write policy.
scenarios.command: cargo run --release -p rumiga-desktop --bin rumiga-desktop -- --model a600 --cpu 68000 --hdf $RUMIGA_A600_HDF --capture target/evidence/a600-hdf/rumiga.png --capture-manifest target/evidence/a600-hdf/rumiga.json --capture-frames 6000 $RUMIGA_A600_ROM
notes: Separates A600 Gayle/RDB evidence from the A1200 HDF baseline.

scenarios.milestone: A1200 Kickstart 3.x no-disk insert screen renders without edge wrap.
notes: Fast visual guard for AGA insert-screen and viewport regressions.

scenarios.milestone: Workbench 3.1 boots from ADF and presents correct native geometry.
notes: ADF path complements A1200 HDF boot evidence and keeps trackdisk regressions visible.

scenarios.milestone: Workbench 3.1.4 HDF reaches desktop or classified media requester with clean viewport edges.
notes: Near-term release evidence pack for A1200, Gayle IDE, HDF, viewport, and manifest integrity.
Use RUMIGA_HDF_SNAPSHOT for write-path evidence without mutating the source image.

scenarios.milestone: Twenty approved AGA titles cover palettes, HAM8, sprites, scrolling, and high-resolution modes.
notes: Catalog group placeholder; expand into per-title scenarios as legally usable assets are selected.
Do not promote Workbench-only success to full AGA compatibility.

scenarios.milestone: A2065 is present, SLIRP link is up, and packet counters are recorded.
notes: Default link evidence does not require a configured guest TCP/IP stack.
Packet capture must remain local-fixture only or be redacted before sharing.

scenarios.milestone: Guest Amiga TCP stack configures A2065, pings gateway, resolves DNS, fetches HTTP, and validates checksum.
required_assets: RUMIGA_NETWORK_HDF with A2065/SANA-II driver and TCP/IP stack
notes: This is the promotion gate from link-ready network evidence to functional guest TCP evidence.

scenarios.milestone: CLI, REST API, and web UI expose the same completed controls for machine, viewport, storage, audio, screenshot, and network.
notes: DTO and endpoint parity is automated; interactive UI parity still needs browser-level acceptance coverage.

scenarios.milestone: Explicit exclusion: PPC and accelerator-board parity are outside the current enterprise target.
notes: Do not count this as a regression or release blocker.

scenarios.milestone: Explicit exclusion: third-party SCSI controller support is outside the current enterprise target.
notes: Gayle IDE HDF is the supported hard-disk path for this roadmap.

scenarios.milestone: Explicit exclusion: RTG/Picasso96 is outside the current native-chipset target.
notes: Viewport and border correctness must be proven on native OCS/ECS/AGA output, not hidden by RTG.
